about_story:
`gLegend of the Golden Dragon is a homage to the classic BBS text adventures of the '80s and '90s.

In a world full of danger, dark monsters, and ancient legends, travelers fight for glory, gold, and the defeat of the fearsome Golden Dragon.

Build your character, visit the town square, battle in the forest, and conquer a place in the rankings!`w
share_dialog_text:
`gWord of mouth travels faster than a dragon on the wind!

Share LOGD with your friends and battle together in the town square.`w
rate_dialog_text:
`yEnjoying your adventures in the realm?

Leave a 5-star review to support the creators and attract more travelers to the village!`w
feedback_dialog_text:
`cHave a suggestion for a new feature or found a bug?

Let us know! Your feedback helps improve the realm.`w
privacy_dialog_text:
`wAt LOGD we respect every traveler's privacy.

• We only collect your email address and character name for account management.
• Passwords are stored securely encrypted via Supabase Auth.
• We never sell or share your data with third parties.
• You can permanently delete your account and data at any time.`w
